messages:
Mara: Quick standup on the launch creative + routing. Need a tight narrative for latency vs unit cost that sales can use in outreach.
Alex: Goal: one hero visual that non-technical folks understand (latency vs $/1k) and a tech appendix for SREs (p95/p99 violin + throughput chart).
Sam: I'll prepare three assets: scatter (median latency x, $/1k y, by deployment), stacked cost-at-scale, violin for tail variance. CSV will include: deployment_mode, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_req.
Priya: Headline options: 1) "Make inference economics visible" 2) "Lower unit costs, predictable tails". Leaning to #1 for broad appeal. Subhead: "Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — same interface, clearer costs."
Noah: For lead routing: if Expected_RPS >= 75 OR Compliance mentions SOC2/PCI/HIPAA -> Enterprise queue. If Expected_RPS between 20-75 tag as "white-glove" and route to AE. Else Growth. Add tags: Interest=latency|cost|throughput.
Jen: Webinar: 30 mins. Runbook: 8m narrative + 7m demo (scatter + live drilldown), 10m tech deep-dive (violin + throughput), 5m Q&A. CTA: "Run your workload on Redwood — tailored latency & cost brief in 48h."
Mara: Landing form fields: Expected_RPS, Avg_Tokens, Compliance_Requirements, Preferred_Benchmark (latency/cost/throughput). Hidden: Demo_Priority = true if RPS >= 75. Mark Source=webinar.
Alex: Note for copy: be explicit how tokens counted (prompt + response) and that Dedicated numbers assume reserved, baseline capacity. No vendor naming. Use "up to" carefully with median stats.
Sam: Upload CSV and figma frames by COB today. I'll include a small sample JSON for the demo requests.
Priya: I'll draft the landing page and three outreach blurbs (PM, infra, platform eng) and post for review.
Noah: SFDC field mapping to confirm: Expected_RPS__c, Avg_Tokens__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Benchmark_Preference__c, Demo_Priority__c, Lead_Source__c. I'll sync with ops to wire Zapier.
ops-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for 2026-07-20 16:00 UTC. Confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Action items recap: Sam CSV + assets, Priya landing + copy, Jen outreach list, Noah SFDC mapping. Ping back in thread with status updates. :thumbsup:
